standard_prerequisites: the condition of lemma-finite-type-red of the same chapter: B/b is generated over A by finitely many classes, where b is the ideal of topologically nilpotent elements
b is an ideal of definition of the weakly admissible Noetherian ring B
the definition of topologically of finite type via density of the image of a polynomial map
core_obligations: Prove that an arrow varphi : A -> B of WAdm^Noeth satisfying the finite-type-after-reduction condition of lemma-finite-type-red is topologically of finite type
proof_roadmap: Choose b_1,...,b_r mapping to generators of B/b over A and b_{r+1},...,b_s generating the ideal b, and consider the A-algebra map A[x_1,...,x_s] -> B sending x_i to b_i.

Every element of b^n is a B-linear combination of monomials of total degree n in b_{r+1},...,b_s; expanding the coefficients modulo b expresses each such element as an image plus an element of b^{n+1}.
Induction gives B = image plus b^n for every n, so the image is dense; since b is an ideal of definition, the map is topologically of finite type.
difficulty_reason: H3: a density induction expanding monomials in the ideal of definition against the reduced generators.
